confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates of July 2026 London price levels, expressed in USD at approximate recent sterling-dollar levels; not checked against live listings or web price pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable. July peak-season hostel and hotel rates, and the size of a 'standard serving' of beer, are least certain. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (roughly 2x and 1.4x) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 2026-10-14 RBA figure came from web search summaries of rba.gov.au; the RBA page itself was not opened directly, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city used. London is priced on its own terms as a top-tier Western European capital, with rough cross-checks against other high-demand European capitals for restaurant and accommodation levels.
